metadata.title: Retro Gig Poster with Sunset Gradient

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical event poster featuring a vibrant pink-to-orange-to-yellow linear gradient background, framed by a white border and set against a textured brown brick wall. The layout uses centered, heavy black typography and a central cartoon vignette of a musician on stage.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black text against a bright warm-toned gradient
Symmetrical vertical alignment of all typographic elements
Central illustrative window acting as a focal point between text blocks
Repetition of illustrative motifs (chili peppers) within the lower branding
coreInvariants: Linear vertical gradient from magenta to bright yellow
Heavy slab-serif or bold transitional serif typeface
White outer margin separating the poster from the brick texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main artist name is scaled largest at the top third; the venue name is secondary in the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central rectangular cartoon illustration of a guitarist on stage.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan starting from the promoter name, through the artist, to the central image, and ending at the venue and date details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room provided by the gradient background around the central image and text blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm gradient (Magenta, Orange, Yellow) providing a sunset-like atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for all primary text and outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and green within the chili pepper illustrations and stage curtains.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout the background with high value contrast between the black text and yellow center.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool tones like blue or purple in the background
No gradients on the text itself

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, high-contrast serif with thick slabs and vertical stress.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Integration of cartoon chili peppers as replacements for specific characters in the venue name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and sizes for consistency.
graphicDevices: Cartoon chili peppers with sunglasses and faces
Rectangular frame for the central illustration

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif aesthetic and high contrast.
Provides the necessary high contrast and traditional feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical poster with a smooth linear gradient from hot pink at the top to bright yellow in the middle, returning to orange-red at the bottom. Place a white border around the edge. Center a small rectangular cartoon illustration of a guitarist on a stage with yellow spotlights and red curtains. Place the entire poster on a textured brown brick wall background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a heavy black slab-serif font like Clarendon, center-align the event details. Use the largest size for the artist name at the top. In the bottom section, replace specific letters in the venue name with cartoon chili pepper characters wearing sunglasses.

verificationChecks: Is the gradient smooth and vertically oriented?
Is the text solid black and centered?
Are the chili peppers integrated into the bottom text?

adjustableVariables: Specific character substitutions in the venue name
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the gradient
Check that the brick wall background does not distract from the poster
Verify the cartoon illustration is contained within its rectangular frame
Confirm the white border is uniform on all sides
recipe.reuseFormula: Linear warm gradient + centered heavy slab-serif text + central cartoon vignette + white border + brick wall context.
